decisions.reason: As a core formwork system shown prominently for at least two years, it fits the firm's established know-how well and is the kind of product a mature German machinery firm can improve and commercialise through accumulated learning.

The shuttering magnet block is closely related to the firm's apparent magnetic formwork competence, so despite more limited website prominence it is likely kept as a complementary product that the firm can support with existing knowledge.

Its dedicated product-page presence over two years suggests strategic relevance, and its strong overlap with the firm's existing technical base lowers the likelihood of withdrawal under an absorptive-capacity logic.

Although it appears less central than the products with their own pages, it still lies within the firm's related magnetic formwork domain, making retention more likely than exit unless demand proves too narrow.
